description: Source code for managing host paths, lease checks, and manageable device list retrieval in a network management context, with functions for reading host info, counting lines in files, checking lease status, and generating DHCP client files.

methods.name: CosaDmlGetHostPath
methods.description: Retrieves host path string from hosts table based on MAC address.

methods.name: countlines
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in a specified file.

methods.name: IsLeaseAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a lease is still available for a given MAC address.

methods.name: CosaDmlGetManageableDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of manageable devices read from a file.

methods.name: buildDhcpVendorClientsFile
methods.description: Creates a DHCP vendor clients file listing IPv4 and IPv6 managed devices.
